title: THE STYLING PASS, STAGE C: ONE PANEL FOR THE RAID HUD
why: His order of 2026-10-03: styling across all menus and HUDs. Five HUD boxes (conditions, the pillager board, both legends and the backpack) each drew their own flat black rectangle with a thin stroke. They share one panel now: rounded corners, a slight gradient, a steel border and a hairline of light along the top, so the HUD reads as one set of instruments. Every position, size and hit box is what it was.
now: The raid HUD panels share one look: rounded, softly shaded, one border.
